answer: Bond depreciation tends to discourage hoarding: a 120-unit bond locked 10 epochs loses 4% per epoch unless work refreshes it, so basalt value slowly erodes. Below 60 units residual, it is downgraded and loses rewards, while forgery costs 50% of the remainder plus a 6-epoch freeze. A raven watching 1,000 idle bonds sees it: 120,000 invested, 4,800 lost per epoch, over 40,000 gone after 10 idle epochs, as the horizon of profit recedes.
